entities.summary: William Robertson Davies was a Canadian novelist, playwright, critic, journalist, and professor. He was one of Canada's best known and most popular authors and one of its most distinguished "men of letters", a term Davies gladly accepted for himself. Davies was the founding Master of Massey College, a graduate residential college associated with the University of Toronto. Robertson Davies was a writers & intellectuals from Thamesville (1913-08-28, Thamesville–1995-12-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
